reviewer_item: NHSJS Recommended 3: a plot or analysis relating baseline residual B, maximum intermediate residual and paired AUC difference
question: Per saved call, how are the all-baseline squared residual B, the largest interior saved squared residual and the paired difference Delta = AUC_Q - AUC_N related? Descriptive only; no causal claim.
pre_outcome_knowledge: The frozen headline paired values and the paper's descriptions of B, extreme calls and first calls are already public (paper Section on overshoots; analysis/paired_rescoring/results/2026-10-01-v1). The RDT-1B paired values were computed by oneb_success 2026-10-23-v1 before this protocol. No correlation, bin count or figure of this analysis was computed before this protocol.

headline.inputs: authenticated with analysis.paired_rescoring.analyze.authenticate on the frozen protocol's Q (logpi) and L2 cohorts; last physical occurrence
headline.recompute: analysis.paired_rescoring.analyze.paired_curve with the cohort's native scale, dimension 512, epsilon 1e-12; every recomputed call must exist in the frozen calls.csv.gz and match its delta, residual_baseline and residual_points exactly (float equality), and every frozen row must be recomputed, otherwise the analysis fails

oneb.inputs: the three primary runs of analysis/paired_rescoring/oneb_success/protocol.json, authenticated with analysis.paired_rescoring.oneb_success.authenticate (the Month 5 sensitivity run is not used)
oneb.recompute: paired_curve as in oneb_success; every recomputed delta must equal the committed oneb_success calls.csv.gz value exactly
oneb.language_policy: RDT-1B language is reported per run only because the seed-42 language baseline was zeroed while seeds 142 and 242 used encoded baselines

per_call_variables.B: residual_baseline: the all-baseline squared residual recovered from the stored baseline score
per_call_variables.max_interior_residual: max(residual_points[1:-1]): the largest squared residual among the seven interior saved nodes (1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50 and 75 percent)
per_call_variables.ratio_max_interior_to_baseline: max_interior_residual / B; undefined when B is 0
per_call_variables.overshoot: at least one saved ordinate with squared residual above both endpoint residuals (n_high_distance_overshoot > 0)
per_call_variables.fully_in_range: no overshoot and no undershoot ordinate

statistics.spearman: Spearman rank correlation with average ranks for ties (Pearson correlation of ranks, math.fsum sums), per case, of Delta with B and of Delta with ratio_max_interior_to_baseline, over three subsets of defined calls: all, fully_in_range, overshoot; undefined (null) when fewer than 3 calls or a constant variable
statistics.bins: per case, defined calls counted in bins of B (left-closed decades from B_edges, plus below the first and at or above the last edge), in bins of the ratio (right-closed intervals from ratio_edges, plus at or below the first and above the last edge), and in every nonempty joint B-by-ratio bin; each bin reports n_calls, n_first_calls, n_overshoot_calls, n_fully_in_range_calls, n_negative_delta, n_delta_below_minus_1, n_delta_below_minus_100, and min, median and max Delta

bins.edge_parsing: edges are decimal strings parsed with float(), which rounds correctly on every platform

figures.encoding: x: B on a log scale; y: Delta on a symmetric log scale, linear for |Delta| <= 0.25; color: log10(ratio_max_interior_to_baseline) on a diverging blue-gray-red scale centered at 0 (the overshoot boundary), values outside the limits drawn at the end colors and counted; marker: circle for later calls, black-edged triangle for first calls; a hairline at Delta = 0; no titles or captions
figures.reproducibility: matplotlib Agg backend, DejaVu Sans, PDF saved with metadata CreationDate None, PNG at 300 dpi

outputs.calls.csv.gz: one row per case and saved call with the per-call variables
outputs.correlations.csv: Spearman correlations per case and subset
outputs.bins.csv: B, ratio and joint bin counts per case
outputs.checks.json: exact-equality checks against the frozen and committed calls and roster counts
outputs.provenance.json: protocol, source and artifact SHA-256 hashes, figure and software environment

scope_limits: Descriptive only: no causal account of why some calls overshoot or why some B values are small
Spearman coefficients are within-case summaries of dependent calls (shared episodes and recorded contexts), not inferential tests; no p-values or intervals
Interior saved nodes are a nominal percentage grid; unobserved intermediate interventions are not inferred
